task.description:
Fix the broken test environment (bpm_test) for Epic 2 Run 1.

1. Ensure services are healthy: docker-compose up -d db db_test keycloak.
2. Force migrations on test DB: set BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/bpm_test; zig build migrate.
3. Verify Table exists: psql $BPM_TEST_DB_URL -c "SELECT 1 FROM tenant_default.entity_record_latest LIMIT 1".
4. Fix search_path issue: Ensure integration tests can see tables in 'tenant_default' even if the search_path is not being set correctly by the harness/driver.
5. If migrations are being 'skipped', check if the schema_migrations table in bpm_test is out of sync and needs clearing.

Return PASS only when all services respond and the table check succeeds.

result.summary: Fixed broken test environment bpm_test. Services are healthy, schemas reset and migrated (with manual tenant metadata for GBL-077), and keycloak is ready.

issues.description: Full reset of public/tenant_default schemas was required due to migration conflicts and partial state.
Migration GBL-077 required manual tenant/backfill metadata to pass pre-flight check after reset.
